dynamic_review_rule_source_policy: Any repo-relative path actually inspected during local branch review is also a valid rule_source.
checkpoint_default_policy: Commit only already staged changes unless the caller explicitly passes --paths or --all.
autopilot_policy: Autopilot may checkpoint, mark local review bundles ready, run independent AI review, and refresh review feedback automatically inside one session, but it must not auto-merge.
acceptance_mode_policy: Scoped mode is the default local review mode: unscoped imported acceptance-source bullets are context/audit inventory, while only explicit scope files create scoped approval-blocking evidence. Strict mode preserves the older all-imported-requirements blocking behavior.
independent_review_policy: Medium/high-risk approval persistence requires a fresh AI-generated independent review artifact for the reviewed head commit, with known and distinct implementer/reviewer identity/session values in the durable artifact and no tracked, unapproved untracked, or ignored run-state mutations by the reviewer. Codex child review fails closed under CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED unless CODEX_CHILD_NETWORK_ALLOWED=1 is explicitly set for that launch.
